title: How Does the Partner Take Care of Himself During a Long Labor?
card: Labor can run for a day or more, and a partner who forgets to eat runs out of steam right when she needs him. How to keep yourself fed, rested and steady for the long haul.
llms: How a birth partner takes care of himself during a long labor: packing food and drinks and eating on a schedule, resting when she rests, planning who covers short breaks, and staying steady, with dads' and moms' survey words, a doula's interview, and NHS pages on early labor and fainting.
